summary: Wrote /app/bin/summarize.py, which parses all six export formats (XML, CSV, TSV, JSONL, and fixed-width layouts read from docs/layouts) using units, date conventions and layouts stated in each file. It applies the duplicate-priority rules, and its output is saved to /app/out/summary.json. The shape checker passes, but it does not check values and I did not verify them independently.
